What’s Streaming on HBO Max?

HBO Max has a wide selection of original TV series, including House of the Dragon , The Last of Us , Succession , Game of Thrones , Hacks , Rooster , Dune: Prophecy , The Pitt , The Sex Lives of College Girls and others. It has hit movies, such as How to Make a Killing , Sinners , Weapons , A Minecraft Movie , The Batman , Barbie and more.

In addition, the streaming service has all sorts of music programming, like Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That’s the Weight of the World) , Yacht Rock: A DOCKumentary , Juice WRLD: Into the Abyss , Woodstock 99: Peace, Love, and Rage , Jason Isbell: Running With Our Eyes Closed , Little Richard: I Am Everything , Love To Love You, Donna Summer and many others.

It has live sports too, with streaming access to games and events from MLB, NHL, NCAA Men’s March Madness, NASCAR and other leagues.

For Prime Day, you can get HBO Max as an add-on channel for Prime Video on sale for $132.99 per year (regularly $184.49 per year) for your first 12 months of service — a 28% savings.
